game_concept: A quiz RPG set in Sand Dunes – Bone Valley, a valley of bleached bones: the sand ranger must handle mirage spirits while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Print Tracer: Insert print statements at the right lines to reveal what mirage spirits changed.
theme: Sand Dunes – Bone Valley: a valley of bleached bones
core_gameplay_loop: Inspect the circuit board, solve the CP1 station, and advance the signal through its gates.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Read score. Display Pass when score ≥ 48; otherwise display Retry. Check below, equal to and above the boundary. This is an exercise cutoff, not the adaptation rule. Test dataset 4: {'score': 47}; {'score': 49}.
controls: Drag the flowchart symbols into connected positions, then Check chart.
win_condition: Construct a complete chart that passes every executable input/output case.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful chart checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Print Tracer' (Week 9 slot 4), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Bone Valley'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Use terminator, input/output, process and decision symbols.
Test the chart with every example input.
source_player_objective: Chain 9 consecutive correct decisions about trace_clarity to power up the sand ranger and open the camel pen.
source_lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
hint: Coordinates begin at the top left. Walls block movement. Use int declarations, observe(value), movement calls, and { } for local scope.
